description: the All-Seeing, a prophet who sees every fate, robes of black and gold covered with glowing golden embroidered eyes, a huge golden eye of light shining behind his head inside a ring of runes, eyes glowing gold, a large golden eye on the chest, glowing pages and cards of the book of fate circling around him, holding a tall staff with a crystal orb in which images of the future swirl, floating a little above the ground, a palette of black, gold and white light; a young man about twenty-five years old, returned to his youth, light skin, long silver-white hair, a youthful handsome clean-shaven face without wrinkles and without a beard, his face clearly visible, well lit and well drawn, with distinct eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth, not in shadow; standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: this design: copy the robes, the glowing golden eyes, the ring of runes, the pages, the staff with the orb, the colours, the pose and the framing; but the man is young again, with a youthful face and no beard
